# `edit`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] edit`

Make targeted edits to a file. Prefer `from`/`to`/`insert_after` content tags from `read`/`grep` (`N tag|text`). `old_string` is the fallback: exact match, then unique whitespace-tolerant match (indent / extra spaces only — not typos). Curly quotes, dashes and CRLF line endings match their plain forms.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | no | Content tag of the first line to replace (inclusive) |
| `insert_after` | string | no | Content tag after which to insert new_string (no deletion) |
| `new_string` | string | yes | The replacement or inserted text |
| `old_string` | string | no | Exact text to find. Required unless from/to/insert_after is set. |
| `path` | string | yes | Path to the file to edit |
| `replace_all` | boolean | no | Replace all occurrences of old_string (default: false) |
| `to` | string | no | Content tag of the last line to replace (inclusive). Omit for a single line. |

## Guide

The model reads this with `read agent://tools/edit`.

Make targeted edits. Prefer `from`/`to`/`insert_after` tags from `read`/`grep`.
`old_string` is the fallback: exact match, then unique whitespace-tolerant match.
A `.ipynb` is edited as `read` shows it. A changed code cell loses its outputs;
a `# %% [code] cell:new` marker adds a cell, removing a block deletes one.
